summary: Show the descendant-inclusive spend of an omp agent's current native root in the web Details pane, read from the web server's root-detail relay.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild of persisted state.

schema.detail: No database, wire or client-v0 schema changes. The browser decodes the relay answer with its own allowlist.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Live pages now ask GET /v1/client/usage/root-detail for an omp agent with a verified current root when its Details pane is open. A server without the relay answers 404 from the gateway; the page then stops asking and Details shows subagent activity as not available, as before. Fixture pages make no request.

downtime.detail: No startup work. An open Details pane refreshes every thirty seconds and gives up on one read after 215 seconds.

manual.detail: No operator action. Spend appears once the server sets WF_ROOT_DETAIL_URL.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; no persistent state changes.
